verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the machine-readable OpenAPI document, which labels the Attio REST API as version "2.0.0". Nothing in the pack describes a versioning scheme, a changelog, or any deprecation or sunset policy. missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme (e.g. versioned endpoints or version headers), a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a changelog or migration guidance for API versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Attio exposes a public OpenAPI specification for the Attio REST API.
